messages.author: Liam
messages.content_text:
july 2 Notes:


I unfortunately took two losses today, and I think they might have been able to be prevented, but I am still happy with the trades I took.
,
Going into the day I had a really hard time identifying my bias, but by the time 10:00 came, I was bullish because we had rejected out of a daily fvg, and the 4h bullish close was good confirmation in my opinion. Price traded lower and gave a 5min rb that rejected off of a 5min cisd. I entered and got stopped out instantly because from here we were super bearish and I completely got my bias wrong. Should have trusted my initial instict. (Screenshot 1)
,
The second trade I took was a limit order, and it was a bit like trying to catch a falling knife, but if I had a bit of a bigger stop then I would have gotten at least breakeven, maybe a recovering win instead of a loss. The level was a daily cisd and we had consolidated right before hiting it creating el, so I put my limit and got stopped out right before it made a 100pt move. it is very unfortunate because I took it on micro charts, but on the mini it actually would have played out as well. No matter though, 300 dollar loss on the day. All I have to do is keep trading smartly. (Screenshot 2)
,
The 10:00 setup I should have been looking at today was shorts because we had swept overnight session highs and then we made an smt with pre market highs. 10:00 opened highers, made a 5min rb and traded lower, but once putting the limit on 10:00, we missed the trade by 5 points and then rallied. This is just the unfortunate reality of trading sometimes, but this would have also prevented that first loss today. (Screenshot 3)
,
I marked out one other level today and it delivered 200 points after tapping it and it was a 4h rejection block, and it was the same story as the level I took. We put in a swing low right before it, swept it and then made a big move up after tapping the level. (Screenshot 4 & 5)
,

So I’ve had a rough past few months since getting that $10K payout in January and I’ve realized that it’s because I’ve completely gone against the system I had going. Waking up on time, doing things before getting on the charts, n things like that.

My goal for July (or the rest of the summer really) is to get out of this slump by following a system.

I will:

Wake up @ 9am every day (and actually get out of bed)
,
Make my bed, brush my teeth, rinse my face, and drink some water before opening my laptop
,
Trade at my desk
,
Following my trading rules
,
Post what I'm looking for in here
,
Be more active in the community
,

I will not:

Trade from my bed
,
Hesitate on setups
,
Revenge trade
,

Trading Rules:

Document EVERY trade (post on YT & TikTok)
,
Strategy: RBs, KOs, Fib
,
2 trades/day MAX
Lockout at 1W, Lockout at 2L
,
,
Target 1:5 (go BE at 1:3)
,
